name: Add Tests for a Module
description: Create a workflow that adds comprehensive tests for a module using the test harness

data.label: Analyze Module
data.prompt: Analyze the module at {{input.modulePath}} and create a test plan covering all exported functions, edge cases, and error handling.

data.label: Write Tests
data.prompt: Write comprehensive tests for {{input.modulePath}} based on the test plan. Include unit tests, integration tests, and edge case tests. Use the project's existing test framework.

data.label: Run Tests
data.prompt: Run the test suite to verify all tests pass. Fix any failures.
